answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Recognized campaign medal roll with medals office attestation makes the industry visible: a roll the office holds across years of awards. The thread is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the echo is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The horizon is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
